Initial release of Audio Trimmer

- Trim and export audio files (MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV, up to 500MB) via cloud GPU processing.
- Simple setup: automatic connection and token generation for first-time users.
- Supports file upload, silence trimming, clip export (1080p MP4), credits check, and session management.
- Handles errors and backend prompts with clear user feedback.
- Designed for podcasters, content creators, and students needing fast audio edits.
